The image shows a single Asian pear on a dark cloth surface, not a meal on a plate or bowl, so there is no plate to use as a ruler. I estimated its size from the fruit itself. It looks round, roughly 9-10 cm in diameter, and the sticker is about 3 cm wide, which fits that size. A round pear of that size has a volume of about 450 cm³. At a density of about 0.95 g/cm³ that comes to roughly 400 g. Asian pears like this commonly weigh 300-450 g, so I chose 380 g.
